Uralungal Cooperative Society Chairman Rameshan Palleri Dies at 66

Rameshan Palleri, the chairman of the Uralungal Labour Contract Cooperative Society (ULCCS), has passed away at the age of 66. The ULCCS is known for executing infrastructure projects for the Kerala government. Palleri had been serving as the chairman of the society.
